files.name: motion-prompt-113.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "High-key" (ハイキー), one of the names in "Photo looks, lighting & styles".
Motion Prompt #113

What it is: A bright, white-toned image with very light shadows
What the sample shows: The landscape and the person turn to light, near-white colours with very faint shadows, and the hump of the histogram at the bottom right moves to the right end.
Spec:
- Scene 3: a bust on the left (head centre x 140, y 82, radius 28 px) and hills, a house, trees and the sun (x 432, y 54, radius 15 px) on the right. 
- Colour: sky #FAF9F7 → #FFFFFF, hills #EAEDF1 → #F5F6F8, figure #4D5A75 → #B9C0CE, shadow #33405A → #A6AEBF, sun #F5A524 → #FFD889
- Histogram (96×46 px, 20 bars): peak centre 0.56 → 0.85, width 0.2 → 0.09
- Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
When to use it: For clean, light, gentle product shots and portraits.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/113.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/photo.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
